admin.publication.save.description: Button that saves the publication settings on the costs screen or the supporters screen.

admin.publication.save_failed.defaultMessage: 公開範囲を保存できませんでした：{reason}
admin.publication.save_failed.description: Shown beside the save button when the publication settings could not be saved; reason is the server's localized reason.

admin.publication.saved.defaultMessage: 公開範囲を保存しました。
admin.publication.saved.description: Shown beside the save button after the publication settings are saved.

admin.publication.unchanged.description: Shown beside the save button of the publication settings when nothing was changed.
